workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:

- Tue 13:00-13:30 or 13:30-14:00
- Tue 16:30-17:00

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:

We have a problem: there appear to be no available slots next week for all four partners. Should we report this as infeasible?

infeasible.reason: After checking all corrected slots provided by Alison, there are no 30-minute time slots next week (Nov 16-20, 9-17 ET) where all four partners (Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto, and David Okafor) are simultaneously free. Every slot where Priya and Marcus are free conflicts with either Elena's or David's calendar (or both). I also prematurely sent a confirmation email for Thu 14:30-15:00, but Alison corrected that Marcus has a dentist appointment then, making that slot invalid as well.
